subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: What supported capacity and upgrade behavior should `openclaw config set --batch-file` guarantee before a hard rejection limit is introduced?
rationale: The implementation choice is mechanically sound, but selecting a permanent public CLI capacity limit changes existing script behavior and cannot be inferred from the hook-metadata precedent or contributor size estimates.

options.title: Define and document a supported limit
options.body: Choose a batch-file limit with an explicit compatibility rationale, then retain this bounded-reader approach with fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Preserve current acceptance for now
options.body: Do not introduce a hard batch-file cap until maintainers have a supported capacity and migration or alternative-input plan.

recommendation.title: Define and document a supported limit
recommendation.body: Choose a batch-file limit with an explicit compatibility rationale, then retain this bounded-reader approach with fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their explicit presence on the PR review timeline makes them the closest available routing contact for the public CLI contract choice.
